newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Oct construction spending rose 1.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Oct construction spending rose 1.8 pct.

text.p: U.S. Commerce Department seasonally adjusted construction spending, with comparisons.

PERCENT CHANGES: Oct Sept--Rev from Oct96/95
Wall Street economists expected a 1.0 percent drop in October construction spending instead of an increase.
Construction spending in 1992 dollars, which discounts the effects of inflation:
Annual Rates, Billions of U.S. Dollars --
The 1.8 percent increase in October construction spending was the largest for any month since last March when spending rose 2.3 percent, the department said.
The department revised August construction spending to a 1.0 percent rise from a 0.7 percent increase.

It revised August private construction spending to show an increase of 1.8 percent instead of 1.4 percent reported a month ago. August public spending was revised to show a 1.5 percent decrease rather than a 1.4 percent drop.
